{{Short description|none}}
This is a list of all the [[ultra prominent peak]]s (with [[topographic prominence]] greater than 1,500 metres) in [[Africa]]. Also shown is Mount Catherine in Sinai, Egypt which is not geographically part of Africa. Not listed here are the 5 Ultras of the Canary Islands and Madeira which near the African Coast but listed under [[List of European ultra prominent peaks#Atlantic islands|Europe]].
